functions.name: lime_project_name
functions.description: Returns the project's name as a constant C string. Use this to query the compiled-in project name for display, logging, or configuration. No parameters, returns a const char*; ownership and lifetime are not documented.
requirements: Caller must treat the returned pointer as read-only (const) and must not modify the string.
Ownership/lifetime are unspecified; callers must not free the returned pointer unless separately documented by the library.

functions.name: lime_magic
functions.description: Returns an unsigned integer "magic" value identifying the library/build. Typically used as a constant identifier or sanity check in clients.

functions.name: lime_version_major
functions.description: Returns the library's major version number as an integer. Useful for runtime version checks and compatibility gating.

functions.name: lime_version_minor
functions.description: Returns the library's minor version number as an integer. Useful for runtime version checks alongside the major version.
